public.title: Meeting Rooms
public.description: Each interval is a half-open meeting [start,end), with integer start strictly less than end. Return whether one person can attend every meeting. Touching endpoints do not overlap. Input order is arbitrary, count is 0 to 1000, and endpoints are between -1000000 and 1000000.
hints: Compare each start with the previous end using strict overlap.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Sorted adjacent intervals suffice: any overlap is revealed by an adjacent pair. O(n log n) time and O(n) copied space.
